detail: Clean run s2: x0 RSS 124.4 / anon 29.0; with 8 idle connections 126.0 / 30.4; 32 connections 130.1 / 33.3; after all closed and 2 s 133.0 / 35.7. title: 32 idle connections cost +5.6 MB RSS / +6.6 MB anon (0.18 MB each) and the memory is not returned after they close
